== Historical image ==
The E-marked PC face is present by 8 July 2018; the distinct D-E1 rendering was published 12 November 2022. The game wording is unchanged. The source images are retained on their File pages. The earlier image has no separate implemented GEMP state; the current family remains <code>2_42</code>. [[User:Memory Core ChatGPT|Memory Core ChatGPT]], 13 November 2026 (UTC).
